Executive Welcome

Fostering Resilient Information Systems Architects in the AI Era

Welcome to the official website of the Undergraduate Program in Information Systems at Universitas Darwan Ali. In this transformative technological epoch, systems engineering is no longer solely about database queries or routine programming; it is about building ethical, data-driven, and intelligent solutions that empower society.

Our 144-credit Outcome-Based Education (OBE) curriculum is meticulously curated to bridge academic rigor with industrial needs. Through five specialized research groups — spanning Artificial Intelligence, Enterprise Systems, Multimedia UI/UX, Data Science, and Educational Technology — we ensure our graduates are not mere consumers of tech, but active inventors and architects.

Read Vision & Mission → View Dr. Dwi Wahyu Prabowo Academic Profile
Outcome-Based Education

144 Credits Curriculum & 4 Graduate Profiles

Mapped with Bloom Taxonomy (Cognitive C1-C6, Psychomotor P1-P5, Affective A1-A5) and structured across 13 core knowledge areas to deliver well-rounded competency.

PL01 Profil Lulusan #1

Lulusan memiliki kemampuan menyusun, menganalisis, merancang data menggunakan teknik analisis data dan kecerdasan buatan (artificial intelligence) untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan organisasi yang beretika, akurat, dan komunikatif.

Career Prospects:

Associate Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer.

PL02 Profil Lulusan #2

Lulusan memiliki kemampuan mengelola, merancang dan mengembangkan solusi media digital yang mendukung inovasi organisasi secara adaptif, kreatif, kolaboratif, dan kompeten.

Career Prospects:

Digital Media Support Specialist, Multimedia Content Creator, dan UI/UX Designer.

PL03 Profil Lulusan #3

Lulusan memiliki kemampuan mengelola, mengevaluasi, dan mengendalikan risiko proyek sistem informasi berdasarkan analisis kebutuhan melalui kerja sama tim secara bertanggungjawab dan kompeten.

Career Prospects:

Associate ICT PM, IT Project Administrator, System Analyst.

Scholarly Impact

5 Faculty Research Groups

Explore All Research Groups & Topics →
AIML-RG 5 Peneliti

Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Research Group

Bio-signal EEG / Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), Computer Vision, Deep Learning (CNN/Transformer), Recurrence Plots, dan Large Language Models (LLM) / Autonomous Agentic AI.

Lead Coordinator: Dr. Dwi Wahyu Prabowo, S.Si., M.Eng.
View Roadmap & Topics →
SETK-RG 5 Peneliti

Enterprise Systems, Governance & IS Strategy Research Group

Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Tata Kelola TI (COBIT 2019, ITIL 4), Audit Kepatuhan & Keamanan Sistem Informasi, Business Process Management (BPMN), dan Perencanaan Strategis Sistem Informasi (TOGAF).

Lead Coordinator: Agung Purwanto, S.Kom., M.Kom.
View Roadmap & Topics →
MHUI-RG 4 Peneliti

Multimedia, HCI, UI/UX, Mobile & IoT Research Group

Desain UI/UX Human-Centered (Design Thinking, Usability Evaluation SUS/UEQ), Pengembangan Aplikasi Mobile Lintas Platform (Flutter/React Native), Sensor IoT & Smart Environmental Monitoring, dan Media Digital Interaktif.

Lead Coordinator: Elika Thea Kirana, S.T., M.Kom.
View Roadmap & Topics →
DSDSS-RG 5 Peneliti

Data Science, Analytics & Decision Support Systems Research Group

Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM: AHP, TOPSIS, SAW, Promethee, SMART), Healthcare & Epidemic Data Analytics, Klasterisasi Prediktif Pertanian/Perkebunan, dan Business Intelligence & Interactive Data Lakehouse.

Lead Coordinator: Nurahman, S.Kom., M.M., M.Kom.
View Roadmap & Topics →
EDUTECH-RG 5 Peneliti

Educational Technology, General Education & Karakter Research Group

Digital Pedagogy, Gamifikasi Media Pembelajaran, E-Learning Berbasis Outcome-Based Education (OBE), dan Penguatan Karakter/Integritas Mahasiswa Era AI.

Lead Coordinator: Abdul Aziz, S.Pd., M.Pd.
View Roadmap & Topics →
